subject: Capacity triage: temporary allocation plan for RallyPoint / Q3 burst
messages:
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Capacity triage: RallyPoint burst next week (need allocation decision)

Team — quick escalation. RallyPoint (RP-2026-1473) is asking for a sustained burst of 120 T4-equivalent GPUs for 72 hours starting 2026-08-26 to support a new customer pilot they committed to during the contract signature. Sales pushed a higher commit in the MPA but engineering flagged we don’t have spare Dedicated pool capacity at those dates.

I need a concrete allocation plan and preference guidance by EOD: do we (A) honor the burst by reassigning part of the Dedicated pool (impacts two medium-priority customers), (B) offer rapid Dedicated burst on Dedicated+ (paid premium) and wait 24-48h for provisioning, or (C) throttle non-committed customers + enable model-variant fallbacks + provide credits?

Key constraints:
- RP has signed a 12-mo Dedicated contract but their commit is moderate (2x reserved). The burst is above their committed baseline but tied to a revenue milestone (pilot -> ARR expansion).
- We have one other near-term high-throughput customer (OrbitAI) with an SLA request and reserved capacity through 2026-09-05.
- We cannot spin new Dedicated GPUs in region-us-west faster than 36 hours without manual approval.

Attached: capacity_projections_Q3.xlsx (quick run-rate) and the latest MPA redline (rallypoint_mpa_patch_v2.pdf).

Short answers please — if you need me to loop Legal/Finance, say so.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity triage: RallyPoint burst next week (need allocation decision)

Stephanie — thanks for the context. Quick infra summary after checking the scheduler and pool commitments:

- Current Dedicated GPU pool (us-west) utilization by reserved customers: 92% baseline; two customers (OrbitAI and Solstice) have committed steady-state lanes through 2026-09-05.
- We have ~48 T4-equivalent GPUs in the flexible burst buffer (Dedicated+) that are tagged for short-term uplift but require manual approval and cost reallocation. Provisioning additional on-prem racks is not an option in the timeframe.
- Soft-eviction policy: we can apply 20–30% soft-throttle to non-committed customers (best-effort) for short windows; that would free ~30–40 GPUs.

Options and tradeoffs:
A) Reassign Dedicated capacity from lower-priority reserved customers — technically doable but requires contract exceptions and proactive notifications (legal & customer success).
B) Use Dedicated+ burst (paid) — fastest (~3 hours) but costs ~2.8x and we absorb allocation operational load.
C) Apply soft-throttle + model-variant fallbacks — lowest risk to contracts, but RP may not accept degraded throughput/latency for pilot.

My recommendation: combine B + C: offer RallyPoint a Dedicated+ burst for the initial 48 hours to guarantee SLA for pilot kickoff, paired with a negotiated credit if they convert to higher reserved commit within 30 days. Meanwhile, apply targeted soft-throttle on non-committed jobs to recover an additional 20 GPUs if needed.

If Sales wants to prioritize RallyPoint over OrbitAI (move their jobs), we need a formal approval chain: Sales lead, CS, Legal sign-off on credit/penalty, and infra ops runbook authorization.

— Marcus
Head of Infra Operations
marcus@redwood.ai
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 19 Aug 2026 12:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity triage: RallyPoint burst next week (need allocation decision)

Agree with Marcus. Sales perspective: RallyPoint is likely to expand if pilot meets latency/cost SLA — this is a near-term greenfield expansion with estimated ARR +$480k/year on conservative conversion. We should favor a short, guaranteed experience.

Proposed commercial trade:
- Approve Dedicated+ burst for 48 hours immediately (we invoice at burst-rate).
- If RallyPoint signs a 6-12 month incremental reserved commit within 30 days, we credit 50% of the burst overage back to MPA as a one-time credit.
- Put OrbitAI on notice: no preemption of their reserved baseline; only soft-throttles on unreserved jobs.

I will draft the short addendum and get Legal involved if you approve. Also recommend informing CS to prepare a communication plan for any affected customers.

— Dylan Brooks
Senior Enterprise Sales
dylan@redwood.ai
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@rallypoint.ai>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: partnerops@rallypoint.ai
Date: Fri, 20 Aug 2026 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity triage: RallyPoint burst next week (need allocation decision)

Thanks Stephanie / Dylan — appreciate the fast coordination. A 48-hour guarantee plus the credit framework is workable for us; the pilot kickoff cannot be degraded (latency spikes will break onboarding). We can sign a 6-month uplift if the pilot metrics hold.

Two asks from our side: can you confirm the expected latency SLA (p99 under test load) and whether any model-variant fallback would be allowed during the second 24-hour window only if we agree? Also, please include an explicit escalation contact during the burst window.

— Alex Rivera
Head of Integrations
RallyPoint AI
alex.rivera@rallypoint.ai
From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.ai>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@rallypoint.ai>, partnerops@rallypoint.ai
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 17:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Capacity triage: RallyPoint burst next week (need allocation decision)

Final decision and runbook: after discussions with Marcus, CS (Marissa) and Finance, we will: 

1) Approve a 48-hour Dedicated+ burst window for RallyPoint starting 2026-08-26 06:00 UTC. Infra to allocate from Dedicated+ buffer; cost will be invoiced to RallyPoint at burst rates.
2) Provide a conditional credit: if RallyPoint signs an incremental 6-month reserved commit (>=3x baseline) within 30 days, we will credit 50% of the burst overage back to their MPA as a one-time credit (DocuSign addendum in related_links).
3) No preemption of OrbitAI reserved baseline; only soft-throttle of unreserved jobs; infra to limit soft-throttle to 20% per-customer CPU/GPU for the 48-hour period.
4) SLAs: Infra commits to p99 latency target under test load: 750ms for generation endpoints; if we need to enact model-variant fallbacks, we will only do so in the optional second 24-hour extension and only with RallyPoint written consent.
5) Escalation contacts during window: Marcus Lin (ops), Marissa Cole (CS), and Stephanie Nguyen (sales).

Marissa — please prepare the external notification and CS playbook. Marcus — please confirm the scheduler plan and run the provisioning by 2026-08-25 COB. Dylan — draft the addendum and route to Legal/Finance for sign-off.

Thanks all for the quick turnaround.

— Stephanie Nguyen
Director, Sales — Strategic Accounts
Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.ai
